summary: This article explains how handball combines running, jumping, and throwing at speed, the basic rules and scoring, and the different jobs players do on the court.
introduce: Write “Alike” and “Different” at the top of a T-chart on the board and ask students to compare two school subjects in one minute. Explain that “Handball: Fast-Paced Team Play” asks them to make the same kind of comparison.

keyTerms.def: having control of the ball during a game
a player who stands near the goal and uses their body to create space for teammates
a team's turn trying to move the ball forward and score

challengeTerms.def: how fast something is moving in a certain direction
the curved path an object follows as it moves through the air
the force an object has because it is moving, which depends on its speed and mass

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that jumping into the air to shoot is the most exciting part of handball? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Imagine you are coaching a new handball team. Explain how possession changes between attack and defense.
struggling: Pre-teach possession, pivot, and attack with pictures or gestures, then let weak readers fill in a T-chart of alike and different with sentence starters.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use velocity, trajectory, and momentum in a short paragraph that compares two ideas from the article and explain which difference matters most.
